value.answer: A vulnerability in macOS Screen Sharing, tracked as CVE-2026-65400, is under active exploitation, allowing attackers to gain full control of Macs. The flaw, with a severity rating of 7.1 out of 10, stems from an authentication flaw in the Screen Sharing feature, enabling attackers to bypass login credentials and install cryptocurrency miners like Monero.
